entry.title: v1.0.3 — launcher-styled delete, skin fixes
entry.summary: Profile deletion now uses a launcher-styled modal in all 14 languages, plus custom-skin/avatar pipeline fixes and glass-tint polish.

entry.title: v1.0.2 — Discord community server
entry.summary: Rich Presence now shows a Join button pointing to the official Discord community. Site footer and nav link to the server too.

entry.title: v1.0.1 — auto-update, telemetry, macOS
entry.summary: One-click silent auto-update with SHA-256, anonymous telemetry, in-app news notices, macOS (Intel + Apple Silicon), RSS feed.

entry.title: v1.0.0 — first public release
entry.summary: Discord Rich Presence, self-update check, multi-size icons, GitHub Actions auto-builds, Linux build, sources on GitHub.
